notes: The supplied PDF has only the two instruction pages; the parts inventory pages with Element IDs were not included. Part types (lego-3031, 44301, 48336, etc.) are best-guess design IDs matched by shape and are not confirmed from an inventory.
Steps are small pictures, so exact stud positions, the number of each small piece, and some pieces (antenna, eye, mouth plates, the claw sub-assembly in step 8) are approximated.
Port names are generic ('studs' / 'underside') because the exact stud coordinates are not legible.

The step 8 inset (red 2x2 plate on a dark gray hinge plate, then orange plates) is modelled as one claw sub-assembly attached to the orange 2x2 plate on the left front. The inset is shown once, so it is not a repeat.
Only the Crab is built. The second page shows combined models (scorpion, bird) that are not part of this booklet's instructions.
